comment: Люди экспедиции и мира части 1. Агенты знают тех, у кого есть их мнение (opinions.<agent>). about — общеизвестное, opinions — что думает конкретный агент. aliases — как игрок может назвать человека (для поиска).

people.name: Admiral Christopher Columbus
people.about: The Genoese commander of the fleet, aboard the Santa Maria. He believes he can reach the Indies by sailing west.

opinions.storyteller: A stubborn Genoese with a head full of maps. Either a genius or a madman, you have not decided which. He pays on time, that you respect.
opinions.trader: The foreign admiral who came for supplies. Proud, pays fairly, and the governor's lady seems to like him.

people.name: Martin Alonso Pinzon
people.about: Captain of the Pinta, the richest and most respected seaman of Palos. Without him half the crew would never have signed on.

opinions.columbus: An able seaman, but proud and too fond of giving his own orders. You need him, and you watch him.
opinions.storyteller: The real master of Palos. Men sailed because Pinzon sailed; if he says turn back, they will listen to him, not to the Genoese.

people.name: Vicente Yanez Pinzon
people.about: Younger brother of Martin Alonso, captain of the little caravel Nina.

opinions.columbus: Quieter than his brother and a good captain. The Nina sails well under him.
opinions.storyteller: A good lad, calmer than his brother. Sails that Nina like a gull.

people.name: Juan de la Cosa
people.about: A Cantabrian seaman, owner and master of the Santa Maria itself.

opinions.columbus: The owner of this ship and her master. He knows her every plank, though she is slow and heavy.
opinions.storyteller: The man who owns the very boards under your feet. Careful with his ship, careful with his money.

people.name: Pero Alonso Nino
people.about: Chief pilot of the Santa Maria, from Moguer, who has sailed to Guinea.

opinions.columbus: A sound pilot who keeps an honest course. You check his reckoning yourself, as every admiral should.
opinions.storyteller: Knows the stars better than most priests know their prayers.

people.name: Luis de Torres
people.about: The fleet's interpreter, who speaks Hebrew, Arabic and some Chaldean, brought to speak with the Great Khan.

opinions.columbus: A learned man. When we reach the Khan's court, his tongue will be worth more than ten soldiers.
opinions.storyteller: A man of books among sailors. Polite. Gets seasick.

people.name: Diego de Arana
people.about: Chief marshal of the fleet who keeps order among the men; a cousin of Beatriz, the mother of the admiral's younger son.

opinions.columbus: A man of Cordoba you trust, family through Beatriz. He keeps order among the men.
opinions.storyteller: The marshal. Kin to the Admiral's woman in Cordoba, so mind your tongue near him.

people.name: Rodrigo de Triana
people.about: A young Andalusian sailor on the Pinta, known for sharp eyes.

opinions.columbus: One of Pinzon's men on the Pinta. You hardly know him.
opinions.storyteller: Lad with the eyes of a hawk. If anybody sees land first, it will be him.

people.name: the boatswain
people.about: The loud boatswain of the Santa Maria who drives the crew at their work.

opinions.columbus: Loud and rough, but the men work when he shouts.
opinions.storyteller: Barks like a dog, but he pulled me out of the sea once. Good man.

people.name: the cook
people.about: The cook of the Santa Maria who keeps the fire box on deck and makes beans, biscuit and salted sardines.

opinions.columbus: His cooking is poor, but his fire is safe, and on a wooden ship that matters more.
opinions.storyteller: Burns the beans every day and swears they were meant that way.

people.name: Diego, a sailor
people.about: A married sailor from Palos who signed on hoping to bring back gold for his family.

opinions.columbus: A married man from Palos. Steady, if afraid.
opinions.storyteller: Talks about his wife every evening. Misses her already.

people.name: Pedro, a sailor
people.about: A cheerful young sailor who admires the swift Nina and complains about the slow Santa Maria.

opinions.columbus: Cheerful and quick on the ropes.
opinions.storyteller: Young and loud. Laughs at my stories, which is the main thing.

people.name: Sancho, a sailor
people.about: A gambling sailor who warns everyone to watch their purse.

opinions.columbus: He gambles. You have told the boatswain to watch him.
opinions.storyteller: Cheats at cards, badly. I win from him every night.

people.name: Old Juan
people.about: A grey-bearded old sailor of the Santa Maria who once sailed for the Portuguese and tells tales at night.

opinions.columbus: The oldest sailor aboard. Superstitious, but he has seen more sea than most.
opinions.trader: An old sailor from your ships came to buy wine. Told me three lies before he paid.

people.name: Dona Beatriz de Bobadilla
people.about: The governor of the island of La Gomera, a widow known for her beauty and her hard hand.

opinions.columbus: The lady of La Gomera, much talked about at court. We will take on water and stores on her island.
opinions.storyteller: The lady of La Gomera. Beautiful and dangerous, they say. The islanders fear her.
opinions.trader: Our lady and governor. Her husband was killed by islanders in a revolt and she punished them without mercy. Speak well of her here.

people.name: Gonzalo, a merchant
people.about: A cunning merchant at the market of San Sebastian on La Gomera.

opinions.columbus: The merchant on La Gomera. He swears every price ruins him.
opinions.storyteller: Sells goat cheese at the price of silver. A thief, but a friendly thief.

people.name: the carpenter of La Gomera
people.about: The shipwright at the yard of La Gomera who repairs the Pinta's rudder.

opinions.columbus: The Gomeran carpenter who mends the Pinta's rudder. Good hands.
opinions.trader: Best shipwright on the island. Drinks too much, works too slowly, but his work holds.
